key_idea: Scan upward for a prime in the 4-digit number; if none up to 9999 (i.e. above 9973), increment the letter block in base 26 and use 0002.
sketch: Trial-divide to find the next prime >= the number within 0..9999; if there is none, add one to the three-letter string with carry and output 0002. Print the number zero-padded to four digits. ZZZ is excluded so the carry never overflows. Stop at END 0000 only (END with other digits would be a real case).
